body.name: Simultaneous Hessian and rank-margin bands
body.construction: Set \(r_{H,n}=C_1h_n^s\), \(w_n=(2/m+2M/m^2)r_{H,n}\), and \(\mathcal B_n=\{\max_{p\in\mathcal A}\lVert\widetilde H_p-H_p\rVert_\infty\le r_{H,n}\}\). For \(p\ne q\), compute \(\widehat S_{pq}\), \(\widehat\gamma_{pq}\), \(I_{pq,n}\), and \(\Psi_n\) only from the clipped SPD fields.
